newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Treasury debt at 132.1 bln reais in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Treasury debt at 132.1 bln reais in Jan.

text.p: The net debt of Brazil's National Treasury stood at 132.1 billion reais in January, equivalent to 16.8 percent of gross domestic product, the Treasury said.
The Treasury said in a statement the debt stock was 34 percent higher than in January 1996, when its debt represented 12.9 percent of GDP.
It said 41.1 percent was external debt.
The Treasury added the average nominal cost of domestic debt was almost unchanged from December at 1.84 percent a month compared with 1.82 percent.
In real terms, high January inflation reduced the average cost to 0.07 percent a month compared with an average monthly real cost in 1996 of 1.18 percent.
Brazil's external debt stock in January hit 53.797 billion reais compared with 54.982 billion reais in January last year.
In January, the Treasury paid out 79.25 million reais in servicing costs on its external debt.
